Class Piece

java.lang.Object
chess.pieces.Piece
Direct Known Subclasses:
Bishop, King, Knight, Pawn, Queen, Rook
public abstract class Piece extends Object
Base class for all chess pieces; stores color and position and defines how pieces report moves.
